title: Unify volume descriptor layout (binding 3 = AS_KHR) and push TLAS (KHR)
rationale: Prevent shader–layout mismatches by using a single descriptor set layout for both SDR/HDR volume pipelines when RT is enabled, and standardize TLAS push on KHR APIs.

edits.action: Introduce a helper that builds the volume descriptor set layout. When RT is enabled, define binding 3 as VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR. Reuse the same layout for both SDR and HDR pipelines.

If (rtEnabled && m_topLevelAS!=VK_NULL_HANDLE), write binding 3 using VkWriteDescriptorSetAccelerationStructureKHR via pNext and push with vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR. Otherwise skip binding 3. Add a one-time log confirming the push.

acceptance: No VUID 07990 at pipeline creation for SDR/HDR volume pipelines
